<!doctype html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#b5651d">
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.webmanifest">
<link rel="icon" href="favicon.svg?v=2" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="icon" href="favicon.ico?v=2" sizes="48x48">
<link rel="icon" href="favicon-32.png?v=2" type="image/png" sizes="32x32">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" sizes="180x180" href="icon-180.png?v=3">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Librino">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Pacifico&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<title>Librino</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#faf6f1;--card:#fff;--ink:#3a3128;--sub:#8a7b6c;--accent:#b5651d;--line:#e6dccf}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;font-family:"Hiragino Sans","Yu Gothic",sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:var(--card);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right),calc((100% - 960px)/2 + 16px)) 10px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left),calc((100% - 960px)/2 + 16px))}
.bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.grow{flex:1}
h1{font-size:18px;margin:0;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px}
.logo{font-family:"Pacifico",cursive;font-weight:400;font-size:28px;color:var(--accent);line-height:1.1}
h1 small{font-size:11px;font-weight:400;color:var(--sub)}
input,select,textarea,button{font:inherit;font-size:16px;color:inherit}
input,select,textarea{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 10px;background:#fff;width:100%;min-height:44px}
select{padding:9px 6px;font-size:15px}
textarea{min-height:0;resize:vertical;line-height:1.55}
button{white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid var(--accent);background:#fff;color:var(--accent);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer}
button.primary{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
button.danger{border-color:#b33;color:#b33}
button.icon{padding:0;width:44px;font-size:20px;border-color:var(--line);color:var(--ink)}
button.small{min-height:36px;font-size:13px;padding:4px 10px}
#cloud{font-size:12px;color:var(--sub);cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:6px 10px;background:#fff}
main{max-width:960px;margin:0 auto;padding:12px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) calc(110px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left))}
.filters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
@media(min-width:641px){.filters{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.btag{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;background:#f3e7d8;color:var(--accent);border-radius:11px;padding:1px 8px;margin:3px 4px 0 0;cursor:pointer}
.tagbox{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 8px;background:#fff;min-height:44px}
.tagbox input{border:none;min-height:30px;padding:2px;flex:1;min-width:130px;width:auto;border-radius:0}
.tagbox input:focus{outline:none}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;background:#f3e7d8;color:var(--accent);border-radius:15px;padding:3px 4px 3px 11px;font-size:14px}
.chip button{border:none;min-height:0;padding:0 7px;background:none;font-size:18px;line-height:1;color:var(--accent)}
.seg{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px}
.seg button{flex:1;white-space:nowrap;padding:4px 6px;font-size:14px}
.seg button.on{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.sugg{margin-top:6px}
.cbtns{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:6px}
.cbtns button{white-space:normal;line-height:1.3}
#cropDlg{max-width:760px}
#cropWrap{position:relative;display:inline-block;max-width:100%;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;background:#222;vertical-align:top}
#cropImg{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:56vh;-webkit-user-drag:none;pointer-events:none}
#cropBox{position:absolute;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 9999px rgba(0,0,0,.5);cursor:move;box-sizing:border-box}
#cropBox i{position:absolute;width:30px;height:30px}
#cropBox i::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;top:8px;width:14px;height:14px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--accent);border-radius:3px;box-sizing:border-box}
#cropBox i[data-h=nw]{left:-15px;top:-15px;cursor:nwse-resize}
#cropBox i[data-h=ne]{right:-15px;top:-15px;cursor:nesw-resize}
#cropBox i[data-h=sw]{left:-15px;bottom:-15px;cursor:nesw-resize}
#cropBox i[data-h=se]{right:-15px;bottom:-15px;cursor:nwse-resize}
.sugg .btag{background:#fff;border:1px dashed var(--accent);font-size:13px;padding:3px 10px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(300px,100%),1fr));gap:10px}
.card{min-width:0;display:flex;gap:12px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;cursor:pointer}
.card:active{background:#fdf8f2}
.cover{width:72px;height:104px;flex:none;border-radius:5px;background:#eee center/cover no-repeat;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;color:var(--sub)}
.meta{min-width:0;flex:1;font-size:13px}
.meta .t{font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;line-height:1.35;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;word-break:break-word}
.meta .s{color:var(--sub);display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;word-break:break-word}
.stars{color:#e0a100;letter-spacing:1px;font-size:16px}
.tag{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:0 7px;margin-right:4px;color:var(--sub)}
.ghead{grid-column:1/-1;font-weight:bold;color:var(--accent);border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);padding:4px 2px;margin-top:6px}
.fab{position:fixed;right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right));bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));width:60px;height:60px;min-height:0;border-radius:30px;font-size:32px;line-height:1;padding:0;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 4px 14px #0004;z-index:6}
dialog{border:none;border-radius:14px;max-width:640px;width:calc(100% - 24px);padding:0;max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;color:var(--ink)}
dialog::backdrop{background:#0006}
.pad{padding:16px}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
label{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--sub);margin:12px 0 4px}
.top{display:flex;gap:12px}
.top .cover{width:90px;height:128px}
details{margin-top:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:0 10px}
details[open]{padding-bottom:10px}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;color:var(--sub);padding:0;min-height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center}
.star-input{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.star-input span{font-size:36px;padding:0 4px;line-height:1.2;cursor:pointer;color:#ccc}
.star-input span.on{color:#e0a100}
.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;position:sticky;bottom:0;background:#fff;margin:16px -16px 0;padding:10px 16px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.actions span{display:flex;gap:8px}
.hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--sub)}
.empty{text-align:center;color:var(--sub);padding:40px 0}
.note-text{white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;margin:0}
.vtop{display:flex;gap:14px}
.vtop .cover{width:110px;height:158px}
.vtitle{font-size:18px;font-weight:bold;line-height:1.35;margin:0 0 4px;word-break:break-word}
h4{margin:18px 0 6px;font-size:13px;color:var(--accent)}
@media(max-width:640px){
dialog{width:100%;max-width:100%;height:100dvh;max-height:100dvh;margin:0;border-radius:0}
.pad{padding:16px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) 16px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left))}
.actions{margin-left:-16px;margin-right:-16px}
}
@media(max-width:520px){
.row{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
.top{flex-direction:column}
.top>div:first-child{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
.top>div:first-child .cbtns{margin-top:0}
.vtop .cover{width:96px;height:138px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
<div class="bar">
<h1><span class="logo">Librino</span><small>読書ノート</small></h1>
<span class="grow"></span>
<span id="cloud" title="設定を開く">☁ 未接続</span>
<button id="setBtn" class="icon" aria-label="設定">⚙</button>
</div>
<input id="q" type="search" placeholder="🔍 題名・作者・原作・絵・感想で検索">
</header>
<main>
<div class="seg" id="kinds"></div>
<div class="filters">
<select id="fGenre"><option value="">全ジャンル</option></select>
<select id="fTag"><option value="">全タグ</option></select>
<select id="fStatus"><option value="">全状態</option><option>未読</option><option>読書中</option><option>読了</option></select>
<select id="sort">
<option value="created">登録順</option>
<option value="read">完了日順</option>
<option value="rating">評価順</option>
<option value="title">題名順(50音)</option>
<option value="author">作者順(50音)</option>
</select>
</div>
<div id="yomiWarn" class="hint" style="margin-bottom:8px"></div>
<div id="list" class="grid"></div>
<p class="hint" style="text-align:center;margin-top:28px"><a href="privacy.html" style="color:inherit">プライバシーポリシー</a></p>
</main>
<button id="addBtn" class="fab" aria-label="追加">＋</button>
<!-- 詳細(読む画面) -->
<dialog id="viewDlg">
<div class="pad">
<div class="vtop">
<div class="cover" id="vCover">表紙なし</div>
<div style="min-width:0;flex:1">
<p class="vtitle" id="vTitle"></p>
<div class="hint" id="vAuthor"></div>
<div class="stars" id="vStars" style="margin-top:6px"></div>
<div id="vTags" style="margin-top:4px"></div>
<div class="hint" id="vDates" style="margin-top:6px"></div>
</div>
</div>
<h4>感想</h4><p class="note-text" id="vNote"></p>
<h4 id="vSynLabel">あらすじ</h4><p class="note-text" id="vSyn"></p>
<div class="actions"><button id="vClose">閉じる</button><button id="vEdit" class="primary">編集</button></div>
</div>
</dialog>
<!-- 設定 -->
<dialog id="setDlg"><div class="pad">
<h3 style="margin-top:0">設定</h3>
<label>Google Client ID(READMEの手順で取得)</label>
<input id="clientId" placeholder="xxxxxxxx.apps.googleusercontent.com">
<label>Googleアカウントのメール(任意)</label>
<input id="hintEmail" type="email" placeholder="example@gmail.com" autocapitalize="off">
<p class="hint" style="margin:4px 0 0">入れておくと、アカウントを選ぶ画面が省けます。</p>
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap">
<button id="connBtn" class="primary">Googleドライブに接続</button>
<button id="syncBtn">今すぐ同期</button>
<button id="discBtn" class="danger">接続を解除</button>
</div>
<p class="hint" id="syncStatus">未接続</p>
<p class="hint" style="margin:0"><a href="privacy.html" style="color:inherit">プライバシーポリシー</a></p>
<p class="hint">接続すると、Googleドライブの「読書ノート」フォルダに データ(books.json)と表紙画像が保存され、スマホとPCで同期されます。このアプリが作ったファイルしか触りません。</p>
<hr style="border:none;border-top:1px solid var(--line)">
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
<button id="exportBtn">バックアップを書き出し</button>
<button id="importBtn">読み込み</button>
<input type="file" id="importFile" accept=".json" hidden>
</div>
<div class="actions"><span></span><button id="setClose" class="primary">閉じる</button></div>
</div></dialog>
<!-- 範囲を指定して表紙にする -->
<dialog id="cropDlg">
<div class="pad">
<h3 style="margin-top:0">表紙にする範囲を選ぶ</h3>
<p class="hint" style="margin:0 0 8px">ドラッグで範囲を指定します。四隅をつかむと大きさ、中をつかむと位置を変えられます。</p>
<div class="seg" id="ratioSeg">
<button type="button" data-r="0" class="on">自由</button>
<button type="button" data-r="0.6667">本の比率 2:3</button>
<button type="button" data-r="1">正方形</button>
</div>
<div style="text-align:center"><div id="cropWrap"><img id="cropImg" alt=""><div id="cropBox"><i data-h="nw"></i><i data-h="ne"></i><i data-h="sw"></i><i data-h="se"></i></div></div></div>
<p class="hint" id="cropMsg" style="color:#b33;min-height:1.4em;margin:8px 0 0"></p>
<div class="actions">
<button type="button" id="cropCancel">キャンセル</button>
<span><button type="button" id="cropAll">全体を使う</button><button type="button" id="cropOk" class="primary">この範囲を使う</button></span>
</div>
</div>
</dialog>
<!-- 本の編集 -->
<dialog id="dlg">
<form id="form" method="dialog" class="pad">
<div class="seg" id="kindSeg">
<button type="button" data-kind="book">📖 本</button>
<button type="button" data-kind="video">🎬 映像</button>
<button type="button" data-kind="game">🎮 ゲーム</button>
</div>
<div id="lookupBox">
<label>ISBN または 題名で検索して自動入力</label>
<div style="display:flex;gap:6px">
<input id="lookup" placeholder="ISBN(978...)または題名">
<button type="button" id="lookupBtn">検索</button>
</div>
<div id="results" class="hint"></div>
</div>
<p id="noLookup" class="hint" style="display:none">映像作品・ゲームは、題名などを手入力してください。画像は「画像を選ぶ」から入れられます。</p>
<div class="top" style="margin-top:10px">
<div>
<div class="cover" id="coverPrev">表紙なし</div>
<input type="file" id="coverFile" accept="image/*" hidden>
<div class="cbtns">
<button type="button" id="coverBtn" class="small">画像を選ぶ</button>
<button type="button" id="capBtn" class="small" style="display:none">画面をキャプチャ</button>
</div>
</div>
<div style="flex:1">
<label>題名 *</label><input id="title" required>
<label id="creatorLabel">作者</label><input id="author">
<details id="yomiBox"><summary>50音順用のよみ(ひらがな)</summary>
<label style="margin-top:0">題名のよみ</label><input id="titleYomi" placeholder="例:ぼっちゃん">
<label id="creatorYomiLabel">作者のよみ</label><input id="authorYomi" placeholder="例:なつめそうせき">
</details>
<div id="origBox"><label id="origLabel">原作者</label><input id="original" placeholder="なければ空欄"></div>
<div id="illBox"><label>イラストレーター(小説など)</label><input id="illustrator"></div>
<div id="platBox" style="display:none"><label id="platLabel">プラットフォーム</label><input id="platform" list="platforms"><datalist id="platforms"></datalist></div>
</div>
</div>
<label>表紙画像URL(画像を選んだ場合は空欄)</label><input id="cover" placeholder="自動取得されます">
<p class="hint" style="margin:6px 0 0">「画像を選ぶ」で、写真やスクリーンショットから範囲を指定して取り込めます。パソコンでは Ctrl+V で貼り付けもできます。</p>
<div class="row">
<div><label>ジャンル(手入力)</label><input id="genre" list="genres"><datalist id="genres"></datalist></div>
<div id="isbnBox"><label>ISBN</label><input id="isbn"></div>
</div>
<label>タグ(細かい分類。Enterか「,」で追加)</label>
<div class="tagbox"><span id="tagChips"></span><input id="tagInput" placeholder="例:ミステリ、泣ける、再読したい" enterkeyhint="done"></div>
<div id="tagSuggest" class="sugg"></div>
<div class="row">
<div id="purchaseBox"><label>購入日(不明なら空欄)</label><input type="date" id="purchase"></div>
<div><label id="readLabel">読了日(不明なら空欄)</label><input type="date" id="read"></div>
</div>
<label>状態</label>
<select id="status"><option>未読</option><option>読書中</option><option selected>読了</option></select>
<label>評価</label>
<div class="star-input" id="stars"></div>
<label id="synLabel">あらすじ</label><textarea id="synopsis" rows="4"></textarea>
<label>感想</label><textarea id="note" rows="6"></textarea>
<div class="actions">
<button type="button" class="danger" id="delBtn">削除</button>
<span>
<button type="button" id="cancelBtn">キャンセル</button>
<button type="submit" class="primary">保存</button>
</span>
</div>
</form>
</dialog>
<script>
const KEY = "reading-notes-v1", CFGKEY = "reading-notes-cfg";
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const esc = s => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c]));
let books = [], cfg = { clientId: "", connected: false };
try { books = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || "[]"); } catch(e) {}
try { cfg = { ...cfg, ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CFGKEY) || "{}") }; } catch(e) {}
const persist = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(books)); } catch(e) { alert("端末への保存に失敗しました(容量不足の可能性)。バックアップを書き出してください。"); } };
const saveCfg = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(CFGKEY, JSON.stringify(cfg)); } catch(e) {} };
const live = () => books.filter(b => !b.deleted);
const coverSrc = b => b.cover || b.thumb || "";
let curTags = [], editingId = null, viewId = null, rating = 0, curThumb = "", pendingFull = "";
/* ---------- 種類(本・映像・ゲーム) ---------- */
const KINDS = {
book: { icon: "📖", name: "本", creator: "作者", statuses: ["未読", "読書中", "読了"], doneDate: "読了日", hasPurchase: true, syn: "あらすじ", platform: null, original: "原作者(原作がある漫画・小説など)" },
video: { icon: "🎬", name: "映像", creator: "監督・制作", statuses: ["未視聴", "視聴中", "視聴済"], doneDate: "視聴日", hasPurchase: false, syn: "あらすじ", platform: { label: "視聴した場所(配信サービス・劇場など)", ph: "例:Netflix、劇場" }, original: "原作(原作者・作品名など)" },
game: { icon: "🎮", name: "ゲーム", creator: "開発・販売元", statuses: ["未プレイ", "プレイ中", "クリア済"], doneDate: "クリア日", hasPurchase: true, syn: "あらすじ・紹介", platform: { label: "プラットフォーム", ph: "例:Switch、PS5、Steam" } },
};
const PLATFORM_DEFAULTS = { video: ["Netflix", "Prime Video", "Disney+", "U-NEXT", "Hulu", "劇場", "テレビ", "DVD/Blu-ray"], game: ["Switch", "PS5", "PS4", "Steam", "スマホ", "PC"] };
const KINDKEY = "reading-notes-kind";
let curKind = "";
try { const k = localStorage.getItem(KINDKEY); if (k && KINDS[k]) curKind = k; } catch (e) {}
const kindOf = b => KINDS[b.kind] ? b.kind : "book";
const statusIdx = b => Math.max(0, KINDS[kindOf(b)].statuses.indexOf(b.status));
function subline(b) {
const k = kindOf(b);
return [b.author, KINDS[k].original && b.original ? "原作: " + b.original : "", k === "book" && b.illustrator ? "絵: " + b.illustrator : "", k !== "book" ? b.platform : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" / ");
}
function datesText(b) {
const K = KINDS[kindOf(b)], parts = [];
if (K.hasPurchase) parts.push(`購入: ${b.purchase || "不明"}`);
parts.push(`${K.doneDate}: ${statusIdx(b) === 2 ? (b.read || "不明") : "-"}`);
return parts.join(" ／ ");
}
/* ---------- 50音順ヘルパー ---------- */
const toHira = s => (s || "").replace(/[ァ-ヶ]/g, c => String.fromCharCode(c.charCodeAt(0) - 0x60));
function sortKey(b, f) {
let k = toHira((b[f + "Yomi"] || b[f] || "")).normalize("NFKC").replace(/^[\s「『(（【\[\-ー・]+/, "").toLowerCase();
if (/^[一-龥]/.test(k)) k = "\uffff" + k;
return k;
}
const ROWS = [["あ行","ぁあぃいぅうぇえぉおゔ"],["か行","かきくけこ"],["さ行","さしすせそ"],["た行","たちつってとっ"],["な行","なにぬねの"],["は行","はひふへほ"],["ま行","まみむめも"],["や行","ゃやゅゆょよ"],["ら行","らりるれろ"],["わ行","ゎわゐゑをん"]];
function groupOf(k) {
const c = (k[0] || "").normalize("NFD")[0] || "";
for (const [n, chars] of ROWS) if (chars.includes(c)) return n;
if (/[a-z]/.test(c)) return "A-Z";
if (/[0-9]/.test(c)) return "数字";
return "その他";
}
/* ---------- 一覧 ---------- */
function render() {
const everyone = live();
const all = everyone.filter(b => !curKind || kindOf(b) === curKind);
const cnt = { "": everyone.length, book: 0, video: 0, game: 0 };
everyone.forEach(b => cnt[kindOf(b)]++);
$("kinds").innerHTML = [["", "すべて"], ["book", "📖 本"], ["video", "🎬 映像"], ["game", "🎮 ゲーム"]]
.map(([k, l]) => `<button type="button" data-kind="${k}" class="${k === curKind ? "on" : ""}">${l} ${cnt[k]}</button>`).join("");
const stNames = curKind ? KINDS[curKind].statuses : ["未着手", "進行中", "完了"];
const curSt = $("fStatus").value;
$("fStatus").innerHTML = '<option value="">全状態</option>' + stNames.map((n, i) => `<option value="${i}">${n}</option>`).join("");
$("fStatus").value = curSt;
const genres = [...new Set(all.map(b => b.genre).filter(Boolean))].sort();
const cur = $("fGenre").value;
$("fGenre").innerHTML = '<option value="">全ジャンル</option>' + genres.map(g => `<option>${esc(g)}</option>`).join("");
$("fGenre").value = genres.includes(cur) ? cur : "";
$("genres").innerHTML = genres.map(g => `<option value="${esc(g)}">`).join("");
const tagCount = {};
all.forEach(b => (b.tags || []).forEach(t => tagCount[t] = (tagCount[t] || 0) + 1));
const tagNames = Object.keys(tagCount).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, "ja"));
const curTag = $("fTag").value;
$("fTag").innerHTML = '<option value="">全タグ</option>' + tagNames.map(t => `<option value="${esc(t)}">#${esc(t)} (${tagCount[t]})</option>`).join("");
$("fTag").value = tagNames.includes(curTag) ? curTag : "";
const q = $("q").value.trim().toLowerCase();
let list = all.filter(b =>
(!q || [b.title, b.titleYomi, b.author, b.authorYomi, b.original, b.illustrator, b.platform, b.note, b.synopsis, (b.tags || []).join(" ")].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(q)) &&
(!$("fGenre").value || b.genre === $("fGenre").value) &&
(!$("fTag").value || (b.tags || []).includes($("fTag").value)) &&
($("fStatus").value === "" || statusIdx(b) === +$("fStatus").value));
const s = $("sort").value;
list.sort((a, b) =>
s === "read" ? (b.read || "").localeCompare(a.read || "") :
s === "rating" ? (b.rating || 0) - (a.rating || 0) :
s === "title" ? sortKey(a, "title").localeCompare(sortKey(b, "title"), "ja") :
s === "author" ? sortKey(a, "author").localeCompare(sortKey(b, "author"), "ja") :
(b.created || 0) - (a.created || 0));
const grouped = s === "title" || s === "author";
let lastGroup = null;
const missing = grouped ? list.filter(b => !b[s + "Yomi"] && /[一-龥]/.test(b[s] || "")).length : 0;
$("yomiWarn").textContent = missing ? `※ よみが未入力の漢字の${s === "title" ? "題名" : "作者"}が${missing}件あります(「その他」にまとまります)。編集画面でよみを入力すると50音順に並びます。` : "";
$("list").innerHTML = list.length ? list.map(b => {
let head = "";
if (grouped) { const g = groupOf(sortKey(b, s)); if (g !== lastGroup) { head = `<div class="ghead">${g}</div>`; lastGroup = g; } }
const src = coverSrc(b);
return head + `
<div class="card" data-id="${b.id}">
<div class="cover" style="${src ? `background-image:url('${esc(src)}')` : ""}">${src ? "" : "表紙なし"}</div>
<div class="meta">
<div class="t">${curKind ? "" : KINDS[kindOf(b)].icon + " "}${esc(b.title)}</div>
<div class="s">${esc(subline(b))}</div>
<div class="stars">${"★".repeat(b.rating || 0)}${"☆".repeat(5 - (b.rating || 0))}</div>
<div>${b.genre ? `<span class="tag">${esc(b.genre)}</span>` : ""}<span class="tag">${esc(b.status)}</span></div>
${(b.tags || []).length ? `<div>${tagHtml(b.tags)}</div>` : ""}
<div class="s">${esc(datesText(b))}</div>
</div>
</div>`; }).join("") : '<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">まだありません。右下の「＋」から登録しましょう。</div>';
}
["q","fGenre","fTag","fStatus","sort"].forEach(id => $(id).addEventListener("input", render));
$("kinds").addEventListener("click", e => {
const x = e.target.closest("button"); if (!x) return;
curKind = x.dataset.kind;
try { localStorage.setItem(KINDKEY, curKind); } catch (err) {}
render();
});
const tagHtml = tags => (tags || []).map(t => `<span class="btag" data-tag="${esc(t)}">#${esc(t)}</span>`).join("");
function filterByTag(t) { $("fTag").value = t; render(); window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" }); }
$("list").addEventListener("click", e => {
const t = e.target.closest(".btag");
if (t) { filterByTag(t.dataset.tag); return; }
const c = e.target.closest(".card"); if (c) openView(c.dataset.id);
});
/* ---------- 星 ---------- */
function drawStars() {
$("stars").innerHTML = [1,2,3,4,5].map(n => `<span data-n="${n}" class="${n <= rating ? "on" : ""}">★</span>`).join("") +
` <button type="button" id="clrStar" class="small">クリア</button>`;
}
$("stars").addEventListener("click", e => {
if (e.target.dataset.n) { rating = +e.target.dataset.n; drawStars(); }
if (e.target.id === "clrStar") { rating = 0; drawStars(); }
});
/* ---------- 詳細(読む画面) ---------- */
function openView(id) {
const b = books.find(x => x.id === id); if (!b) return;
viewId = id;
const src = coverSrc(b), r = b.rating || 0;
$("vCover").style.backgroundImage = src ? `url('${src}')` : "";
$("vCover").textContent = src ? "" : "表紙なし";
$("vTitle").textContent = b.title || "";
const K = KINDS[kindOf(b)];
$("vAuthor").textContent = subline(b);
$("vSynLabel").textContent = K.syn;
$("vStars").textContent = "★".repeat(r) + "☆".repeat(5 - r);
$("vTags").innerHTML = `<span class="tag">${K.icon} ${K.name}</span>` + (b.genre ? `<span class="tag">${esc(b.genre)}</span>` : "") + `<span class="tag">${esc(b.status)}</span>` + tagHtml(b.tags);
$("vDates").textContent = datesText(b);
$("vNote").textContent = b.note || "(まだありません)";
$("vSyn").textContent = b.synopsis || "(なし)";
$("viewDlg").showModal(); $("viewDlg").scrollTop = 0;
}
$("vClose").onclick = () => $("viewDlg").close();
$("vTags").addEventListener("click", e => { const t = e.target.closest(".btag"); if (t) { $("viewDlg").close(); filterByTag(t.dataset.tag); } });
$("vEdit").onclick = () => { $("viewDlg").close(); openDlg(viewId); };
["viewDlg", "setDlg"].forEach(id => $(id).addEventListener("click", e => { if (e.target.id === id) $(id).close(); }));
/* ---------- 編集ダイアログ ---------- */
const F = ["title","titleYomi","author","authorYomi","original","illustrator","platform","genre","isbn","cover","purchase","read","status","synopsis","note"];
function setCoverPrev() {
const u = $("cover").value || curThumb;
$("coverPrev").style.backgroundImage = u ? `url('${u}')` : "";
$("coverPrev").textContent = u ? "" : "表紙なし";
}
/* ---------- タグ入力 ---------- */
function drawTags() {
$("tagChips").innerHTML = curTags.map((t, i) => `<span class="chip">#${esc(t)}<button type="button" data-i="${i}" aria-label="削除">×</button></span>`).join("");
const freq = {};
live().forEach(b => (b.tags || []).forEach(t => freq[t] = (freq[t] || 0) + 1));
const sugg = Object.keys(freq).filter(t => !curTags.includes(t)).sort((a, b) => freq[b] - freq[a]).slice(0, 14);
$("tagSuggest").innerHTML = sugg.length ? '<span class="hint">よく使うタグ: </span>' + sugg.map(t => `<span class="btag" data-tag="${esc(t)}">+ ${esc(t)}</span>`).join("") : "";
}
function addTags(raw) {
String(raw).split(/[,、，]/).forEach(p => {
const t = p.trim().replace(/^[#＃]+/, "").slice(0, 24);
if (t && !curTags.includes(t)) curTags.push(t);
});
drawTags();
}
function commitTagInput() { const v = $("tagInput").value; if (v.trim()) addTags(v); $("tagInput").value = ""; }
$("tagInput").addEventListener("keydown", e => {
if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); commitTagInput(); }
else if (e.key === "Backspace" && !$("tagInput").value && curTags.length) { curTags.pop(); drawTags(); }
});
$("tagInput").addEventListener("input", e => { if (/[,、，]$/.test($("tagInput").value)) commitTagInput(); });
$("tagInput").addEventListener("blur", commitTagInput);
$("tagChips").addEventListener("click", e => { const b = e.target.closest("button"); if (b) { curTags.splice(+b.dataset.i, 1); drawTags(); } });
$("tagSuggest").addEventListener("click", e => { const t = e.target.closest(".btag"); if (t) addTags(t.dataset.tag); });
let editKind = "book";
function buildKindUI(kind) {
editKind = kind;
const K = KINDS[kind], isBook = kind === "book";
document.querySelectorAll("#kindSeg button").forEach(x => x.classList.toggle("on", x.dataset.kind === kind));
$("creatorLabel").textContent = K.creator;
$("cover").placeholder = isBook ? "自動取得されます" : "画像のURL(なければ空欄)";
$("creatorYomiLabel").textContent = K.creator + "のよみ";
$("origBox").style.display = K.original ? "" : "none";
if (K.original) $("origLabel").textContent = K.original;
$("lookupBox").style.display = isBook ? "" : "none";
$("noLookup").style.display = isBook ? "none" : "";
$("illBox").style.display = isBook ? "" : "none";
$("isbnBox").style.display = isBook ? "" : "none";
$("platBox").style.display = K.platform ? "" : "none";
if (K.platform) {
$("platLabel").textContent = K.platform.label;
$("platform").placeholder = K.platform.ph;
const used = live().filter(b => kindOf(b) === kind).map(b => b.platform).filter(Boolean);
$("platforms").innerHTML = [...new Set([...(PLATFORM_DEFAULTS[kind] || []), ...used])].map(x => `<option value="${esc(x)}">`).join("");
}
$("purchaseBox").style.display = K.hasPurchase ? "" : "none";
$("readLabel").textContent = K.doneDate + "(不明なら空欄)";
$("synLabel").textContent = K.syn;
$("status").innerHTML = K.statuses.map(s => `<option>${s}</option>`).join("");
$("genres").innerHTML = [...new Set(live().filter(b => kindOf(b) === kind).map(b => b.genre).filter(Boolean))].sort().map(g => `<option value="${esc(g)}">`).join("");
}
$("kindSeg").addEventListener("click", e => {
const x = e.target.closest("button"); if (!x) return;
const i = $("status").selectedIndex;
buildKindUI(x.dataset.kind);
$("status").selectedIndex = Math.max(0, i);
});
function openDlg(id) {
editingId = id || null;
const kind = id ? kindOf(books.find(x => x.id === id)) : (curKind || "book");
buildKindUI(kind);
const b = id ? books.find(x => x.id === id) : { status: KINDS[kind].statuses[2] };
F.forEach(k => $(k).value = b[k] || "");
if ($("status").selectedIndex < 0) $("status").selectedIndex = 0;
curThumb = b.thumb || ""; pendingFull = b.pendingFull || "";
rating = b.rating || 0; drawStars(); setCoverPrev();
curTags = [...(b.tags || [])]; $("tagInput").value = ""; drawTags();
$("lookup").value = ""; $("results").innerHTML = "";
$("yomiBox").open = !(b.titleYomi && b.authorYomi);
$("delBtn").style.display = id ? "" : "none";
$("dlg").showModal();
}
$("addBtn").onclick = () => openDlg();
$("cancelBtn").onclick = () => $("dlg").close();
$("cover").addEventListener("input", () => { if ($("cover").value) { curThumb = ""; pendingFull = ""; } setCoverPrev(); });
$("form").addEventListener("submit", e => {
e.preventDefault();
commitTagInput();
const data = {}; F.forEach(k => data[k] = $(k).value.trim()); data.rating = rating; data.tags = [...curTags];
data.kind = editKind;
if (editKind !== "book") { data.illustrator = ""; data.isbn = ""; } else { data.platform = ""; }
if (!KINDS[editKind].hasPurchase) data.purchase = "";
if (!KINDS[editKind].original) data.original = "";
if (data.cover) { data.thumb = ""; data.pendingFull = ""; } else { data.thumb = curThumb; data.pendingFull = pendingFull; }
const now = Date.now();
if (editingId) {
const b = books.find(x => x.id === editingId);
if (b.coverDriveId && (data.cover !== b.cover || data.pendingFull)) { if (!data.pendingFull) data.coverDriveId = ""; }
Object.assign(b, data, { updatedAt: now });
} else books.push({ id: String(now), created: now, updatedAt: now, ...data });
persist(); render(); $("dlg").close(); schedulePush();
});
$("delBtn").onclick = () => {
if (!confirm("この本を削除しますか?")) return;
const b = books.find(x => x.id === editingId);
const id = b.id, created = b.created;
books = books.filter(x => x.id !== id);
books.push({ id, created, deleted: true, updatedAt: Date.now() });
persist(); render(); $("dlg").close(); schedulePush();
};
/* ---------- 画像選択(Driveに保存する大きい版+一覧用の小さい版) ---------- */
function resize(img, max, q) {
const r = Math.min(1, max / Math.max(img.width, img.height)), c = document.createElement("canvas");
c.width = Math.round(img.width * r); c.height = Math.round(img.height * r);
c.getContext("2d").drawImage(img, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
return c.toDataURL("image/jpeg", q);
}
$("coverBtn").onclick = () => $("coverFile").click();
$("coverFile").onchange = e => { const f = e.target.files[0]; e.target.value = ""; if (f) openCrop(f); };
/* ---------- 範囲を指定して表紙にする ---------- */
let cropURL = "", cropRatio = 0, crop = { x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0 }, dispW = 0, dispH = 0, cropDrag = null;
const cropImg = $("cropImg"), cropWrap = $("cropWrap"), cropBox = $("cropBox");
function drawCrop() {
cropBox.style.left = crop.x + "px"; cropBox.style.top = crop.y + "px";
cropBox.style.width = crop.w + "px"; cropBox.style.height = crop.h + "px";
}
function defaultCrop() {
let w = dispW * 0.88, h = dispH * 0.88;
if (cropRatio) { if (w / h > cropRatio) w = h * cropRatio; else h = w / cropRatio; }
return { x: (dispW - w) / 2, y: (dispH - h) / 2, w, h };
}
function initCrop() { dispW = cropImg.clientWidth; dispH = cropImg.clientHeight; crop = defaultCrop(); drawCrop(); $("cropMsg").textContent = ""; }
function openCrop(blob) {
if (!blob) return;
if (cropURL) URL.revokeObjectURL(cropURL);
cropURL = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
cropImg.onload = () => requestAnimationFrame(initCrop);
cropImg.onerror = () => { $("cropDlg").close(); alert("この画像は読み込めませんでした。"); };
cropImg.src = cropURL;
if (!$("cropDlg").open) $("cropDlg").showModal();
}
// アンカー(固定する角)と現在の指の位置から、範囲を決める(比率固定・画像の外にはみ出さない)
function rectFrom(ax, ay, px, py) {
const sx = px < ax ? -1 : 1, sy = py < ay ? -1 : 1;
let w = Math.abs(px - ax), h = Math.abs(py - ay);
if (cropRatio) { if (w / (h || 1e-9) > cropRatio) w = h * cropRatio; else h = w / cropRatio; }
const maxW = sx > 0 ? dispW - ax : ax, maxH = sy > 0 ? dispH - ay : ay;
if (w > maxW) { w = maxW; if (cropRatio) h = w / cropRatio; }
if (h > maxH) { h = maxH; if (cropRatio) w = h * cropRatio; }
return { x: sx > 0 ? ax : ax - w, y: sy > 0 ? ay : ay - h, w, h };
}
function ptr(e) {
const r = cropImg.getBoundingClientRect();
return { x: Math.min(dispW, Math.max(0, e.clientX - r.left)), y: Math.min(dispH, Math.max(0, e.clientY - r.top)) };
}
cropWrap.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
e.preventDefault();
const p = ptr(e), hd = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("i[data-h]");
if (hd) {
const k = hd.dataset.h;
cropDrag = { mode: "resize", ax: k.includes("w") ? crop.x + crop.w : crop.x, ay: k.includes("n") ? crop.y + crop.h : crop.y };
} else if (e.target === cropBox) {
cropDrag = { mode: "move", ox: p.x - crop.x, oy: p.y - crop.y };
} else {
cropDrag = { mode: "new", ax: p.x, ay: p.y };
crop = { x: p.x, y: p.y, w: 0, h: 0 }; drawCrop();
}
$("cropMsg").textContent = "";
try { cropWrap.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
});
cropWrap.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
if (!cropDrag) return;
const p = ptr(e), d = cropDrag;
if (d.mode === "move") crop = { ...crop, x: Math.min(dispW - crop.w, Math.max(0, p.x - d.ox)), y: Math.min(dispH - crop.h, Math.max(0, p.y - d.oy)) };
else crop = rectFrom(d.ax, d.ay, p.x, p.y);
drawCrop();
});
["pointerup", "pointercancel"].forEach(t => cropWrap.addEventListener(t, () => { cropDrag = null; }));
$("ratioSeg").addEventListener("click", e => {
const b = e.target.closest("button"); if (!b) return;
cropRatio = +b.dataset.r;
document.querySelectorAll("#ratioSeg button").forEach(x => x.classList.toggle("on", x === b));
crop = defaultCrop(); drawCrop();
});
window.addEventListener("resize", () => { if ($("cropDlg").open) initCrop(); });
function useCover(canvas) {
pendingFull = resize(canvas, 900, .85); curThumb = resize(canvas, 220, .75);
$("cover").value = ""; setCoverPrev(); $("cropDlg").close();
}
$("cropOk").onclick = () => {
if (crop.w < 10 || crop.h < 10) { $("cropMsg").textContent = "範囲が小さすぎます。ドラッグして範囲を指定してください。"; return; }
const s = cropImg.naturalWidth / dispW, sw = Math.round(crop.w * s), sh = Math.round(crop.h * s);
const c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = sw; c.height = sh;
c.getContext("2d").drawImage(cropImg, Math.round(crop.x * s), Math.round(crop.y * s), sw, sh, 0, 0, sw, sh);
useCover(c);
};
$("cropAll").onclick = () => {
const c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = cropImg.naturalWidth; c.height = cropImg.naturalHeight;
c.getContext("2d").drawImage(cropImg, 0, 0);
useCover(c);
};
$("cropCancel").onclick = () => $("cropDlg").close();
$("cropDlg").addEventListener("close", () => { if (cropURL) { URL.revokeObjectURL(cropURL); cropURL = ""; } cropImg.removeAttribute("src"); });
// スクリーンショットの貼り付け(編集画面を開いているとき)
document.addEventListener("paste", e => {
if (!$("dlg").open || $("cropDlg").open) return;
const it = [...(e.clipboardData ? e.clipboardData.items : [])].find(i => i.type.startsWith("image/"));
if (it) { e.preventDefault(); openCrop(it.getAsFile()); }
});
// 画面キャプチャ(パソコンのブラウザのみ)
if (navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia && !matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches) $("capBtn").style.display = "";
$("capBtn").onclick = async () => {
let stream;
try {
stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ video: true, audio: false });
const v = document.createElement("video"); v.muted = true; v.srcObject = stream;
await v.play();
if (!v.videoWidth) await new Promise(r => { v.onloadedmetadata = r; });
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300));
const c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = v.videoWidth; c.height = v.videoHeight;
c.getContext("2d").drawImage(v, 0, 0);
c.toBlob(b => openCrop(b), "image/png");
} catch (err) {
if (!err || err.name !== "NotAllowedError") alert("画面のキャプチャができませんでした。スクリーンショットを撮って、Ctrl+V で貼り付けてください。");
} finally { if (stream) stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); }
};
/* ---------- 書籍情報の検索 ---------- */
const normIsbn = s => s.replace(/[-\s]/g, "");
const isIsbn = s => /^(\d{13}|\d{9}[\dXx])$/.test(normIsbn(s));
async function fromOpenBD(isbn) {
const r = await fetch("https://api.openbd.jp/v1/get?isbn=" + isbn);
const j = await r.json(); const d = j && j[0]; if (!d) return null;
const s = d.summary || {}, o = d.onix || {};
const contribs = (o.DescriptiveDetail && o.DescriptiveDetail.Contributor) || [];
const byRole = role => contribs.filter(c => (c.ContributorRole || []).includes(role)).map(c => c.PersonName && c.PersonName.content).filter(Boolean).join(", ");
const texts = (o.CollateralDetail && o.CollateralDetail.TextContent) || [];
const syn = (texts.find(t => t.TextType === "03") || texts.find(t => t.TextType === "02") || texts[0] || {}).Text || "";
const tt = (((o.DescriptiveDetail || {}).TitleDetail || {}).TitleElement || {}).TitleText || {};
const authorsYomi = contribs.filter(c => (c.ContributorRole || []).includes("A01")).map(c => c.PersonName && c.PersonName.collationkey).filter(Boolean).join("");
return {
titleYomi: toHira((tt.collationkey || "").replace(/[,\s]/g, "")),
authorYomi: toHira(authorsYomi.replace(/[,\s]/g, "")),
title: (s.title || "") + (s.volume ? " " + s.volume : ""),
author: byRole("A01") || (s.author || "").replace(/\/著$|\/著.*$/, ""),
illustrator: byRole("A12"),
synopsis: syn, cover: s.cover || "", isbn: s.isbn || isbn
};
}
async function googleBooks(q) {
const r = await fetch("https://www.googleapis.com/books/v1/volumes?maxResults=8&q=" + encodeURIComponent(q));
const j = await r.json();
return (j.items || []).map(it => {
const v = it.volumeInfo || {};
const id = (v.industryIdentifiers || []).find(i => i.type === "ISBN_13") || (v.industryIdentifiers || [])[0] || {};
return { title: v.title || "", author: (v.authors || []).join(", "), illustrator: "", synopsis: v.description || "",
cover: ((v.imageLinks || {}).thumbnail || "").replace("http://", "https://"), isbn: id.identifier || "" };
});
}
function applyInfo(info) {
["title","titleYomi","author","authorYomi","illustrator","synopsis","cover","isbn"].forEach(k => { if (info[k]) $(k).value = info[k]; });
if (info.cover) { curThumb = ""; pendingFull = ""; }
setCoverPrev();
}
$("lookupBtn").onclick = async () => {
const v = $("lookup").value.trim(); if (!v) return;
$("results").textContent = "検索中…";
try {
if (isIsbn(v)) {
const isbn = normIsbn(v);
let info = await fromOpenBD(isbn);
if (!info || !info.title) { info = (await googleBooks("isbn:" + isbn))[0]; }
else if (!info.cover || !info.synopsis) {
const g = (await googleBooks("isbn:" + isbn))[0];
if (g) { info.cover = info.cover || g.cover; info.synopsis = info.synopsis || g.synopsis; }
}
if (info) { applyInfo(info); $("results").textContent = "入力しました。内容を確認してください(イラストレーターは取れない場合があります)。"; }
else $("results").textContent = "見つかりませんでした。手入力してください。";
} else {
const list = await googleBooks(v);
if (!list.length) { $("results").textContent = "見つかりませんでした。"; return; }
$("results").innerHTML = list.map((b, i) => `<div><a href="#" data-i="${i}">${esc(b.title)}</a> / ${esc(b.author)}</div>`).join("");
$("results").onclick = ev => { const a = ev.target.closest("a"); if (!a) return; ev.preventDefault(); applyInfo(list[a.dataset.i]); $("results").textContent = "入力しました。"; };
}
} catch (e) { $("results").textContent = "取得に失敗しました(通信エラー)。手入力も可能です。"; }
};
$("lookup").addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); $("lookupBtn").click(); } });
/* ---------- バックアップ ---------- */
$("exportBtn").onclick = () => {
const out = live().map(({ pendingFull, ...b }) => b);
const a = document.createElement("a");
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(out, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" }));
a.download = "reading-notes-" + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + ".json"; a.click();
};
$("importBtn").onclick = () => $("importFile").click();
$("importFile").onchange = async e => {
const f = e.target.files[0]; if (!f) return;
try {
const data = JSON.parse(await f.text());
if (!Array.isArray(data)) throw 0;
if (confirm(`${data.length}冊を読み込みます。現在のデータは置き換えられます。よろしいですか?`)) {
const now = Date.now();
const gone = live().map(b => ({ id: b.id, created: b.created, deleted: true, updatedAt: now }));
books = [...gone.filter(g => !data.some(d => d.id === g.id)),
...data.map((b, i) => ({ id: b.id || String(now + i), created: b.created || now, ...b, updatedAt: now }))];
persist(); render(); schedulePush();
}
} catch { alert("読み込めないファイルです。"); }
e.target.value = "";
};
/* =====================================================
Googleドライブ同期
===================================================== */
const SCOPE = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file";
const DRIVE = "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3", UP = "https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3";
const TOKKEY = "reading-notes-tok";
let token = null, tokenExp = 0;
try { const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(TOKKEY) || "null"); if (s && s.exp > Date.now() + 60000) { token = s.t; tokenExp = s.exp; } } catch (e) {}
const hasToken = () => !!token && Date.now() < tokenExp - 60000;
const clearToken = () => { token = null; tokenExp = 0; try { localStorage.removeItem(TOKKEY); } catch (e) {} };
let tc = null, tokenPromise = null, folderId = null, syncing = false, again = false, timer = null;
function setStatus(msg, short) {
$("syncStatus").textContent = msg;
$("cloud").textContent = short || (cfg.connected ? "☁ 接続中" : "☁ 未接続");
}
function ensureToken(interactive) {
if (hasToken()) return Promise.resolve();
if (tokenPromise) return tokenPromise;
tokenPromise = new Promise((res, rej) => {
if (!cfg.clientId) return rej(new Error("Client IDが未設定です"));
if (!(window.google && google.accounts && google.accounts.oauth2)) return rej(new Error("Googleのライブラリを読み込めません(オフラインかも)"));
if (!tc || tc._cid !== cfg.clientId) {
tc = google.accounts.oauth2.initTokenClient({ client_id: cfg.clientId, scope: SCOPE, callback: () => {} });
tc._cid = cfg.clientId;
}
tc.callback = r => {
if (r.error) return rej(new Error(r.error));
token = r.access_token; tokenExp = Date.now() + (r.expires_in || 3600) * 1000;
try { localStorage.setItem(TOKKEY, JSON.stringify({ t: token, exp: tokenExp })); } catch (e) {}
res();
};
tc.error_callback = e => rej(new Error("サインインがキャンセル/ブロックされました(" + (e.type || "") + ")"));
tc.requestAccessToken({ prompt: (interactive && !cfg.hint) ? "select_account" : "", hint: cfg.hint || undefined });
}).finally(() => { tokenPromise = null; });
return tokenPromise;
}
async function api(url, opts = {}) {
await ensureToken();
const r = await fetch(url, { ...opts, headers: { ...(opts.headers || {}), Authorization: "Bearer " + token } });
if (r.status === 401) { clearToken(); throw new Error("認証の期限切れ。再接続してください"); }
if (!r.ok) throw new Error("Drive " + r.status + ": " + (await r.text()).slice(0, 120));
return r;
}
async function ensureFolder() {
if (folderId) return folderId;
const q = encodeURIComponent("name='読書ノート' and mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and trashed=false");
const j = await (await api(`${DRIVE}/files?q=${q}&fields=files(id)&spaces=drive`)).json();
if (j.files && j.files.length) return (folderId = j.files[0].id);
const c = await (await api(`${DRIVE}/files?fields=id`, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
body: JSON.stringify({ name: "読書ノート", mimeType: "application/vnd.google-apps.folder" }) })).json();
return (folderId = c.id);
}
async function findFile(name) {
const q = encodeURIComponent(`name='${name}' and '${folderId}' in parents and trashed=false`);
const j = await (await api(`${DRIVE}/files?q=${q}&fields=files(id)`)).json();
return j.files && j.files[0] ? j.files[0].id : null;
}
async function uploadFile(name, mime, data, existingId) {
const b = "rn" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
const meta = JSON.stringify(existingId ? { name } : { name, parents: [folderId] });
const body = new Blob([`--${b}\r\nContent-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n${meta}\r\n--${b}\r\nContent-Type: ${mime}\r\n\r\n`, data, `\r\n--${b}--`]);
const url = existingId ? `${UP}/files/${existingId}?uploadType=multipart&fields=id` : `${UP}/files?uploadType=multipart&fields=id`;
return (await (await api(url, { method: existingId ? "PATCH" : "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/related; boundary=" + b }, body })).json()).id;
}
const dataUrlToBlob = u => { const [h, d] = u.split(","); const bin = atob(d), a = new Uint8Array(bin.length); for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) a[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i); return new Blob([a], { type: h.match(/:(.*?);/)[1] }); };
async function pullRemote() {
const id = await findFile("books.json");
if (!id) return null;
return await (await api(`${DRIVE}/files/${id}?alt=media`)).json();
}
async function pushRemote() {
const out = books.map(({ pendingFull, ...b }) => b);
const id = await findFile("books.json");
await uploadFile("books.json", "application/json", JSON.stringify(out), id);
}
function mergeRemote(remote) {
const m = new Map(books.map(b => [b.id, b]));
for (const r of remote) { const l = m.get(r.id); if (!l || (r.updatedAt || 0) > (l.updatedAt || 0)) m.set(r.id, r); }
books = [...m.values()];
}
// 表紙画像をDriveに保存(選んだ画像、またはURLの表紙のバックアップ)
async function processCovers() {
for (const b of books) {
if (b.deleted) continue;
try {
if (b.pendingFull) {
b.coverDriveId = await uploadFile(`cover-${b.id}.jpg`, "image/jpeg", dataUrlToBlob(b.pendingFull), null);
b.pendingFull = ""; b.updatedAt = Date.now(); persist();
} else if (!b.coverDriveId && /^https?:/.test(b.cover || "") && !b.archiveFailed) {
let blob = null;
try { const r = await fetch(b.cover); if (r.ok) blob = await r.blob(); } catch (e) {}
if (blob && blob.type.startsWith("image/") && blob.size > 1000) {
b.coverDriveId = await uploadFile(`cover-${b.id}.jpg`, blob.type, blob, null);
} else b.archiveFailed = true;
b.updatedAt = Date.now(); persist();
}
} catch (e) { /* 次回に再試行 */ }
}
}
async function sync(interactive) {
if (!cfg.connected) return;
if (syncing) { again = true; return; }
syncing = true; setStatus("同期中…", "☁ 同期中…");
try {
await ensureToken(interactive);
await ensureFolder();
const remote = await pullRemote();
if (remote) mergeRemote(remote);
persist(); render();
await processCovers();
await pushRemote();
const t = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("ja-JP", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
setStatus("同期済み(" + t + ")", "☁ 同期済み");
} catch (e) {
setStatus("同期できません: " + e.message + "(⚙から「今すぐ同期」を押してください)", "☁ 要再接続");
} finally { syncing = false; if (again) { again = false; sync(); } }
}
function schedulePush() { if (!cfg.connected) return; clearTimeout(timer); if (!hasToken()) { sync(); return; } timer = setTimeout(() => sync(), 1500); }
/* 設定画面 */
$("setBtn").onclick = $("cloud").onclick = () => { $("clientId").value = cfg.clientId; $("hintEmail").value = cfg.hint || ""; $("setDlg").showModal(); };
$("setClose").onclick = () => $("setDlg").close();
$("connBtn").onclick = async () => {
cfg.clientId = $("clientId").value.trim(); cfg.hint = $("hintEmail").value.trim(); saveCfg();
if (!cfg.clientId) return setStatus("Client IDを入力してください");
cfg.connected = true; saveCfg(); clearToken(); folderId = null;
await sync(true);
if ($("cloud").textContent.includes("要再接続")) { cfg.connected = false; saveCfg(); }
};
$("syncBtn").onclick = async () => { cfg.clientId = $("clientId").value.trim() || cfg.clientId; cfg.hint = $("hintEmail").value.trim(); saveCfg(); if (!cfg.connected) cfg.connected = true; saveCfg(); await sync(true); };
$("discBtn").onclick = () => {
if (token && window.google) try { google.accounts.oauth2.revoke(token); } catch (e) {}
clearToken(); folderId = null; cfg.connected = false; saveCfg(); setStatus("接続を解除しました(端末内のデータは残っています)");
};
/* 起動時 */
render(); setStatus(cfg.connected ? "接続設定あり" : "未接続");
let armed = false;
// ポップアップは画面タップの直後でないとブロックされるため、トークンが無いときは最初のタップを待って同期する
function armGesture() {
if (armed || !cfg.connected) return;
armed = true;
setStatus("画面を1回タップすると同期します", "☁ タップで同期");
document.addEventListener("click", e => {
armed = false;
if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest("#setDlg")) return;
if (cfg.connected && !hasToken()) sync();
}, { once: true, capture: true });
}
function startSync() {
if (!cfg.connected) return;
if (hasToken()) sync(); else armGesture();
}
window.addEventListener("load", startSync);
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => { if (document.visibilityState === "visible" && cfg.connected && !syncing) { if (hasToken()) sync(); else armGesture(); } });
if ("serviceWorker" in navigator && location.protocol === "https:") navigator.serviceWorker.register("sw.js").catch(() => {});
</script>
<script src="https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client" async defer></script>
</body>
</html>
